[message_id=694041 author=shark first=True]
Help needed: I’m doing vibe coding in Cursor and submitting via the Kaggle CLI, but it seems I can’t change the GPU type locally. Every time I have to manually open the webpage, switch the GPU to RTX 6000, and then click “Save Version.” Is there a better way to handle this?

[message_id=3447429 author=Ken first=False]
You should be able to use the --accelerator NvidiaRtxPro6000 flag. Note that since it's only available for this competition, you need to ensure your kernel metadata includes
"competition_sources": [
"nvidia-nemotron-model-reasoning-challenge"
]

[message_id=3447455 author=shark first=False]
kaggle kernels push --accelerator NvidiaRtxPro6000 can run success.
